title: COPY THIS FILE to validation/evidence/<ID>/manifest.json and fill every field

seeds.note: list EVERY random source; write 'deterministic, no RNG' if there is none

precision.note: state which stages are float64 and which are arbitrary precision

tolerances.note: state every tolerance actually used, and where it comes from

input_config.note: everything needed to re-run without reading the source

command: python3 <the exact command that regenerates every output>

convergence.sweep: what was varied and over what range
convergence.note: an experiment that exits non-zero BY DESIGN must record that code here, so verification can distinguish it from a regression

notes: A manifest with validation_status PASS while a promotion-blocking blocker is open in its dependency chain is a defect, not a result.
